comment: “Foundational health system functions” is not defined precisely enough to distinguish DPI-H components from widely reused operational platforms. A system may serve several programmes without constituting public infrastructure.

anchor.note: p.64 l.Lines 553-555 read as the printed page; section 3.5.1 agrees

public.text: “Foundational health system functions” is not defined precisely enough to distinguish DPI-H components from widely reused operational platforms. A system may serve several programmes without constituting public infrastructure.
public.suggestedRevision: Define foundational functions using additional tests such as dependency centrality, authoritative responsibility, public-interest value, lifecycle stability, cross-programme reuse, non-discriminatory access, and difficulty of efficient duplication.
